name: Michael Jackson
hook: The King of Pop, from the moonwalk to Thriller and "Billie Jean."

facts.label: Thriller
facts.statement: Thriller was the 1982 album whose title track was written by Rod Temperton; its 13-minute music video premiered in 1983.

facts.label: the moonwalk
facts.statement: Jackson introduced his signature moonwalk, a backwards glide, on Motown's 25th Anniversary special in 1983.

facts.label: Billie Jean
facts.statement: "Billie Jean" was a No. 1 hit about a woman claiming the singer is the father; Quincy Jones wanted the title changed to avoid confusion with a tennis player.

facts.label: Beat It
facts.statement: "Beat It" featured real gang members in its video, and "Weird Al" Yankovic parodied it as "Eat It."

facts.label: Bad
facts.statement: The album Bad followed Thriller and produced five No. 1 hits.

facts.label: King of Pop
facts.statement: Jackson was known as the "King of Pop," the nickname used in dozens of his obituaries.

facts.label: Paul McCartney duets
facts.statement: Jackson duetted with Paul McCartney on "The Girl Is Mine" and the No. 1 hit "Say Say Say."
